title: The Ossan Newbie Adventurer, Trained to Death by the Most Powerful Party, Became Invincible
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Rick Gladiator becomes an adventurer past age thirty, when common wisdom says it is too late. Unknowingly trained to S-rank strength by the legendary party Orichalcum Fist, he faces elite adventurers who scoff at his age (One Peace Books blurb via AniList/MU; ANN review of the anime adaptation).
life_message: It is never too late to chase a dream, and hard work can stand against inborn talent.
